headline: MGM Resorts (MGM) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Mixed Analyst Target Changes
summary: The latest update on MGM Resorts International cuts the modelled fair value from US$49.33 to US$46.02, a reduction of about 6.7% in the target level analysts are using. That move aligns with more mixed research commentary, where some firms trimmed price targets after the withdrawn US$48.30 People Incorporated offer, while discussions continue around how quickly fundamentals and valuation might improve.
